QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Secret Captain's Quarters
QuestInfo.0: You volunteered to hunt down the Prime Minister just to get away from Violetta. The Mushking seems rather disappointed...
QuestInfo.1: Violetta mentioned that there's a puzzle you must piece together to enter the Captain's Quarters, where the Prime Minister is holed up.
QuestInfo.2: You volunteered yourself to hunt down the Prime Minister. You pieced the puzzle pieces together and it turns out to be... Black Viking's selfie?

0.0: We must capture the Prime Minister, the villain behind this chaos. I'm sorry to send you out once again, but I trust that you are most fit and competent. Are you prepared?

0.msg: The Captain's Quarters are on the other side of the Galley downstairs. I heard you have to piece a puzzle together to get in. The #bVikings on the airship#k should have the #r#t4034114##k pieces.

no.0: Very well. Let's start the marriage ceremony right away. I will get prepared.

default.0: I'm not sure what kind of puzzle it is, so get the #r#t4034114##k pieces from the #bVikings on the airship#k and we'll have a look.
